title: Representation of a successful clause parse
statement: Let $f\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ and $r$ be bit strings, and let $C$ be a clause of literals. If parsing $x$ as a clause with fuel $f$ returns $C$ and remainder $r$, then $x$ is the encoding of $C$ followed by $r$.
hypotheses_covered: The clause parser with fuel $f$ returns $C$ and remainder $r$ on input $x$
